programme.title: Michael Carabajal vs Jorge Arce
programme.desc: On July 31st, 1999 Michael Carabajal faced Jorge Arce for the WBO World Light flyweight title at Plaza de Toros El Toreo in Tijuana in a 12 round bout that went 11 rounds giving the bout to Carabajal.

programme.title: Michael Carbajal vs Humberto Gonzalez 1
programme.desc: On March 13th, 1993, Michael Carbajal fought Humberto Gonzalez for the WBC and IBF Light Flyweight Titles in Las Vegas. After being knocked down twice earlier in the fight, Carbajal made an incredible comeback, knocking out Gonzalez in the 7th round.

programme.title: Micky Ward vs Alfonso Sanchez
programme.desc: On April 12th, 1997 Micky Ward and Alfonso Sanchez faced eachother at the Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas the 10 round bout ended after seven giving Ward the victory by technical knockout.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Antonio Margarito 2
programme.desc: On December 3rd, 2011, Miguel Cotto fought Antonio Margarito in a highly anticipated championship rematch at the Madison Square Garden in New York. This time around, Cotto showed his dominance from the start and stopped Margarito in the 9th round.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs DeMarcus Corley
programme.desc: On February 26th, 2005 Miguel Cotto fought DeMarcus Corley for the WBO World Super Lightweight title at the Coliseo Ruben Rodriguez in Bayamon with Corley going down twice in the 5th round securing the technical knockout victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Delvin Rodriguez
programme.desc: On October 5th, 2013 Miguel Cotto battled Delvin Rodriguez at the Amway Center in Orlando, Fl. The originally twelve round bout lasted three rounds and ended by technical knockout in third round securing the victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Joshua Clottey
programme.desc: On June 13th, 2009, Miguel Cotto fought Joshua Clottey for the WBO World Welterweight Title at Madison Square Garden in New York. Despite Clottey landing more shots, Cotto was persistent with his attack, helping him earn a close split decision win.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Kelson Pinto
programme.desc: On September 11th, 2004 Miguel Cotto faced Kelson Pinto at the Coliseo Jose Miguel Agrelot in Hato Rey in battle for WBO World Super lightweight titles with the bout ending halfway through in the sixth round securing the win for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Muhammad Abdullaev
programme.desc: On June 11th, 2005 Miguel Cotto faced Muhammad Abdullaev for the WBO World Super Lightweight title at Madison Square Garden in New York the twelve round bout ended in the ninth securing the victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Ricardo Mayorga
programme.desc: On March 12th, 2011, Miguel Cotto fought Ricardo Mayorga for the World Super Welterweight Championship at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. In a great fight, Miguel Cotto prevailed, knocking down Mayorga in the final round and getting the stoppage.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Sergio Martinez
programme.desc: On June 7th, 2014 Miguel Cotto and Sergio Martinez fought eachother for the WBC world middleweight titles in a bout that ended early in the tenth round with a victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Shane Mosley
programme.desc: On November 10th. 2007 Miguel Cotto fought Shane Mosley at Madison Square Garden in New York City for the WBA World welterweight title in a full 12 round bout that ended in a unanimous decision victory for Cotto.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Yuri Foreman
programme.desc: On June 5th, 2010, Miguel Cotto defeated Yuri Foreman at Yankee Stadium, claiming the WBA Super Welterweight title. Foreman's knee injury hindered his performance and Cotto won by TKO in the 9th round.

programme.title: Miguel Cotto vs Zab Judah
programme.desc: On June 9th, 2007, Miguel Cotto fought Zab Judah in a welterweight championship bout at Madison Square Garden in New York. Cotto emerged victorious with a TKO in the 11th round, solidifying his reputation as a formidable welterweight champion.

programme.title: Mikaela Mayer vs Ewa Brodnicka
programme.desc: On October 31st, 2020 Mikaela Mayer fought Ewa Brodnicka for the vacant WBO World Super Featherweight due to Brodnicka being overweight and losing her title on the scale but Mayer was able to claim the victory by unanimous decision.

programme.title: Mikaela Mayer vs Maiva Hamadouche

programme.desc: This book-inspired murder mystery boasts an all-star cast led by Daniel Craig. When a famous crime writer is found dead, a seasoned detective is enlisted to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Christmas Carole
programme.desc: A modern retelling of Charles Dickens' 'A Christmas Carol'. A mean-spirited businesswoman, who hates Christmas, is visited by ghosts on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Chickenhare & The Hamster Of Darkness
programme.desc: An epic adventure animation adapted from Chris Grine's comic book series. Chickenhare embarks on an adventure to stop his uncle from overthrowing his father, King Peter.

programme.title: Bernard: Mission Mars
programme.desc: A funny, heartfelt space adventure animation for the family. An unlucky agent secretly infiltrates a Mars mission to catch a Martian monster but ends up befriending it.

programme.title: Mr. Peabody & Sherman
programme.desc: This great family animated adventure is about an advanced canine and his adopted son, who endeavour to fix some complications caused by their time travelling.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: A futuristic sci-fi epic helmed by Tom Cruise. A veteran assigned to extract Earth's remaining resources discovers a crashed spacecraft that will change everything he knew.

programme.title: Dog
programme.desc: Channing Tatum drives this heartfelt drama. A former Army Ranger and a military dog are paired against their will on the road trip to a fellow soldier's funeral.

programme.title: Last Seen Alive
programme.desc: Gerard Butler shows there are no limitations when trying to find the truth. After a man's estranged wife disappears, he takes the law into his own hands while evading the authorities.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: This chilling reimagining of a classic tale got four Oscar nominations. When a terrifying vampire becomes infatuated with a young woman, a series of inexplicable horrors is unleashed.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: A modern twist to the 1941 classic werewolf horror. A man fights to protect his family from a wild animal attack, but as the night goes on, he slowly turns monstrous.

programme.title: May December
programme.desc: Natalie Portman and Julianne Moore propel this drama loosely based on a true story. An actress visits a female sex offender she's about to play in a movie to study her and her family.

programme.title: The Wish Of Fairy Fish
programme.desc: An adventure-filled fairy tale fantasy. If you go fishing, be prepared to draw the fish of your dreams, the magical Pike, which can grant any three wishes.

programme.title: Zero To Zero
programme.desc: A moving South African film about Covid-19. Filmed over a year, this unequalled footage from ICU and beyond tells a story of despair, hope and the strength of the human spirit.

programme.title: Reagan
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid leads this captivating biopic about the 40th President of the United States, Ronald Reagan. Delve into his childhood, acting career, and rise to leader of the US.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: Rachel McAdams and Ryan Gosling star in this romantic tearjerker. After being separated, a couple who are passionately in love get a second chance at happiness.

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: A superpowered animation. A supervillain finally defeats his arch-rival, Metro Man. He soon becomes bored and creates a new hero for the town.

programme.title: Rabbit Academy: Mission Eggpossible
programme.desc: An adventure-filled animation. At the bunny school, the magical golden egg is appointing the new 'master bunnies'. After selecting Max, a city bunny, the golden egg turns black.

programme.title: How To Train Your Dragon 2
programme.desc: A beautifully animated Oscar-nominated adventure for adults and kids. This time, Hiccup and his dragon Toothless discover a hidden ice cave that's home to hundreds of new dragons.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: George Clooney becomes Batman in this entertaining superhero film. The Dark Knight must stop Mr. Freeze and Poison Ivy from destroying Gotham City.

programme.title: The Tuxedo
programme.desc: Jackie Chan turns on the charm in this action film. A chauffeur is thrust into the world of international espionage when he puts on a suit that gives him extraordinary powers.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A charming dinner turns into a nightmare in this pulse-pounding thriller. While on a date, a widowed mother receives terrifying anonymous messages to kill her date or lose her son.

programme.title: Cut Throat City
programme.desc: A compelling crime drama set in the aftermath of the destructive Hurricane Katrina. Four friends, desperate to make ends meet, become involved with a local gang and a dangerous heist.
